displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E6.3
meaning: Igniter fault: the igniter relay fails, or the igniter is open.
diySteps: The heating sequence energizes the ignitor for about 20 seconds of warm-up after 1st stage pressure switch 1 closes
Technician: check the igniter and the igniter relay on the control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. An open igniter will not glow, and the gas valve should not be forced on.
